prompt:
Production SPRITE ATLAS for an original cute farm pixel-art game. The attached atlas is a STYLE reference only: use its warm colors, crisp dark pixel outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters, simple friendly small eyes and rounded appealing proportions. Do NOT copy the dog anatomy. Subject: ONE cute tricolor BEAGLE farm dog, round TAN cheeks, broad WHITE face blaze and cream muzzle, COCOA saddle, TWO matching long floppy COCOA ears, TEAL collar with BRASS round tag, FOUR distinct WHITE sock paws, upward curved WHITE-TIPPED tail. Small bright black oval eyes, cheerful personality. Different from the caramel bandana reference dog.
EXACTLY 8 ROWS x 8 COLUMNS = 64 separate whole characters on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Equal cells. Each animal must fit within the middle 60% of its cell with broad transparent gutters on ALL sides. No clipping, shadows, floor, labels or grid lines. Whole tail, ears, feet and wings remain inside each cell.
One genuine direction per row in this EXACT order: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left 45 degrees; 3 WEST/left PROFILE; 4 NORTHWEST/back-left 45 degrees; 5 NORTH/back; 6 NORTHEAST/back-right 45 degrees; 7 EAST/right PROFILE; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right 45 degrees. Front and rear diagonals must visibly differ from straight front, rear and side views. Fixed 20-degree elevated orthographic camera, same physical anatomy, scale, colors and proportions for all 64 poses.
Animation across EACH row: FOUR-legged balanced beagle walking: FOUR distinguishable articulated paws with equal left and right strides. Frame1 contactA,2 downA,3 passingA,4 upA,5 oppositecontactB,6 downB,7 passingB,8 upB. Stable torso and head, small ear and tail follow-through, planted paws sweep back under body, swinging paws lift and return. A complete seamless eight-frame cycle with no repeated endpoint. Keep body center and grounded foot plane stable. Every body part is present throughout the cycle. Deliberate clean PIXEL ART, approximately 64 pixels of detail per animal, no smooth vector style, no gradients, no glossy enormous eyes. Consistent individual face and identity.
